response.sql: WITH account_transaction_avg AS (SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) as account_avg FROM trans GROUP BY account_id), account_with_region AS (SELECT ata.account_id, ata.account_avg, d.A3 as region FROM account_transaction_avg ata JOIN account a ON ata.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id), region_avg AS (SELECT region, AVG(account_avg) as region_figure FROM account_with_region GROUP BY region), all_regions_avg AS (SELECT AVG(region_figure) as global_avg FROM region_avg) SELECT ra.region, ra.region_figure, ra.region_figure - ara.global_avg as exceeds_avg, ra.region_figure / ara.global_avg as figure_ratio FROM region_avg ra CROSS JOIN all_regions_avg ara WHERE ra.region_figure > ara.global_avg ORDER BY ra.region
